title: Ratio of maximum lumbar to hip motion (S/LH, S/RH) in bending, side bending and twisting
condition: healthy, standing, maximal trunk movements in 3 planes

quantity.name: lumbar/hip ratio of maximum movement
quantity.definition: |max lumbar movement| / |max hip movement| per subject, averaged. Lumbar = L1 sensor relative to sacral sensor; hip = thigh sensor relative to sacral sensor (hip-joint angle, NOT pelvis vs global). Lumbar: flexion, left lateral flexion, left axial rotation positive; hip: flexion, abduction, lateral rotation positive.

source.sample: 20 males; 20 healthy young males, no back/leg pain in previous 12 months

protocol.summary: Lumbar-to-hip ratios at end of range for 6 trunk movements in 20 young males (Table 1).
how_to_use: At full forward bending give the lumbar spine ~1.1-1.2 x the hip (pelvis-on-thigh) rotation (about equal shares); in backward bending ~1.2-1.3.
Lateral bending is almost all lumbar (ratio 4-9; ipsilateral hip abducts less than contralateral hip adducts).
Twisting is mostly at the hips (ratio 0.2-0.7): the leading-side hip rotates medially and the trailing hip laterally.
The ratio is to hip-joint motion (thigh vs sacrum); with knees straight and feet fixed this approximates pelvic rotation.

measurement.device: 3SPACE Fastrak (Polhemus): sensors on L1 spinous process, sacrum, lateral left and right thighs; 30 Hz per sensor
measurement.posture: standing, feet shoulder-width (zero = comfortable upright posture)
measurement.task: 3 continuous cycles of max forward-backward bending, left-right lateral bending, left-right twisting, 12 s per trial at comfortable speed; repeated 3 times

protocol.notes: Mean of per-subject ratios, so differs from ratio of mean angles (e.g. forward bending 58.4/54.5 = 1.07). Angle-angle plots (Fig 2): lumbar leads early in forward bending, hip dominates late; reversed in return.

extraction.check_notes: Re-read Table 1 from layout text; SDs of side-bending ratios (0.3-0.4) as printed although small relative to means.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
